title: 2024 Tesla Model 3 Dent Repair and Paint Correction
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed dent repair and paint correction on a 2024 Tesla Model 3 in Vancouver, Washington.
story: This 2024 Tesla Model 3 came in for dent repair and paint and body work correction. Correcting body damage on late-model panels requires thorough surface preparation so filler and primer adhere correctly.

Technicians smoothed out the damaged sections on the rear trunk lid. Sanding removed the damaged finish, allowing body filler to level out the depressions. Masking tape protected adjacent glass and trim from debris and paint overspray during the prep phase.
After blocking the surface smooth, the area was primed and sprayed with color-matched metallic grey paint. Clear coat was applied to match the original factory sheen and protect the new finish.
